mainEntity.name: How can I budget for a home remodel effectively?

acceptedAnswer.text: To budget effectively, start by defining your project scope and prioritizing desired features. Obtain multiple quotes from contractors to understand realistic costs. Allocate an additional 10-20% of your total budget for unexpected expenses or changes. Factor in potential costs like temporary living arrangements, design fees, and furnishings. Clearly communicate your budget to your contractor from the outset to help them guide material selections and design decisions within your financial limits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effectively budget for a remodel by defining your scope, getting multiple quotes, and setting aside 10-20% for contingencies. Communicate your budget clearly with your contractor.
